note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a JOR 12-14; A06b JOR 12-14; L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 4 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Jordan, 2024
sources.said: Person has been regularly resident in Jordan for a period of 4 years preceding the date of the application. Person intends to reside in Jordan. ... The naturalization certificate only will be granted to individuals who renounce his/her former nationality at the time of the naturalization. ... n.a.
